cohort: The study included all women who had singleton vaginal births after 34 weeks of gestation at Innlandet Hospital Trust from 2012 to 2022.
finding: Amniotomy was not found to be a risk factor for OASI in this cohort, but instrumental delivery was confirmed as an independent modifiable risk factor.
mod_finding: Instrumental vaginal delivery (vacuum extraction and forceps) was identified as an independent modifiable risk factor for OASI, while episiotomy and epidural analgesia were associated with reduced risks in vaginally primiparous women.
